errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред на български език
errors.evidence: The description claims the countries on the vertical axis are sorted alphabetically in Bulgarian, but they are not. The order shown is Сиера Леоне (starts with С), Либерия (starts with Л), Гвинея (starts with Г). The correct alphabetical order in Bulgarian would be Гвинея, Либерия, Сиера Леоне.
The description incorrectly expands the abbreviation "щ.д." from the figure's caption as "световни долари" (world dollars). The correct expansion is "щатски долари" (US dollars).
